facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary endpoint of mortality or transplant at 90 days · Phase 2 · larsucosterol in alcohol-associated hepatitis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Numerical improvement in primary endpoint of mortality or transplant at 90 days did not achieve statistical significance
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The numerical improvement in the primary endpoint of mortality or transplant at 90 days did not achieve statistical significance for either dose of larsucosterol.
evidence.safety: Larsucosterol was safe and well tolerated. There were fewer treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) in the larsucosterol arms compared with SOC.
evidence.program_discontinued: Strong rationale for advancing larsucosterol in a Phase 3 registration trial in alcohol-associated hepatitis with reduction in 90-day mortality as the primary endpoint
